research_period: Milan, Paris and Pitti Uomo menswear shows, June 2026; Premiere Vision Paris, February 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Global: Milan, Paris and Florence runways; premium and mid-market menswear
title: SS27 Men's Category Opportunities
summary: Growth categories for SS27 menswear: summer tailoring, shorts, cropped jackets, soft leather, knit polos and shirts, and two-piece sets.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- **Tailoring is adapting, not disappearing:** designers broadly agreed that a well-dressed man still wears a suit, now lighter<sup>[1]</sup>.
- **Shorts:** microshorts in Milan<sup>[1]</sup>, smart shorts in Paris<sup>[2]</sup>, boxer shorts as outerwear<sup>[3]</sup>.
- **Cropped jackets:** the micro jacket<sup>[3]</sup>.
- **Leather:** across Louis Vuitton, Dior, Saint Laurent and Givenchy<sup>[4]</sup>.
- **Sets:** pyjama-inspired sets at Dior and Givenchy<sup>[4]</sup>.
- **Accessories:** Louis Vuitton offered Speedy bags in many colours<sup>[5]</sup>; jewellery and leather goods are projected to grow 4 to 6% a year from 2025 to 2027<sup>[6]</sup>.

sections.heading: Opportunities
sections.body:
1. Summer suits and suit shorts.
2. Cropped blousons, especially leather and suede.
3. Knit polos and knit shirts.
4. Two-piece sets.
5. Bags and accessories in season colours.

sections.heading: Categories to reduce
sections.body: Very oversized tailoring and heavy four-season suits.

design_implications: - Shift development time to summer-weight tailoring and sets.
commercial_implications: - Re-weight open-to-buy towards shorts, sets and cropped jackets.
